title: High capacity peanut shell-based hard carbon as a negative electrode for sodium-ion batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01617C, Paper
Hai-Lang Jia, Ke-Yang Chai, Peng-Cheng Ji, Yu-Jie Lu
Peanut shell-based hard carbon PSHC-2 was prepared using a two-step method of hydrothermal treatment and pyrolysis, exhibiting excellent sodium storage performance.
